items.question: Which article of the UAE Constitution states that equality, social justice, safety, security and equal opportunities are the pillars of society?
items.fact: UAE Constitution Article 14 names equality and social justice as society pillars

items.question: Under the UAE Constitution's provisions on application of laws, is an accused person presumed innocent until convicted by a legal and just trial?
items.gold: Yes, an accused is deemed innocent until convicted by means of a legal and just trial.
items.fact: Accused deemed innocent until convicted by legal, just trial
